blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV revealed that he asked lead prosecutor and Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro to remove his name from the list of witnesses to be presented by the prosecution panel in Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. In a statement on his Facebook page on Thursday, Trillanes said he asked Luistro to withdraw his name to relieve the prosecution panel of the “pressure it is going through.” “Earlier in the day, I requested the House prosecution under Chair Jinky Luistro to formally withdraw my name as a witness for the prosecution.
